root_cause_criterion.variable: the return value of XRef::getEntry(i, complainIfMissing)
root_cause_criterion.obligation: When parseEntry(mainXRefEntriesOffset + 20*i, &entries[i]) fails on the direct xref path, XRef::getEntry must return an initialized dummy entry instead of the unresolved slot &entries[i].
root_cause_criterion.description: On the witnessed path the direct-xref lookup for object 20 fails while i + 1 still exceeds the logical xref size, so the unresolved slot is outside the initialized range. Vulnerable getEntry logs the parse failure and later returns that slot anyway; the fixed image returns a dummy entry on the same parse-failure path, so Parser::makeStream no longer dereferences uninitialized flags.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The staged patch.diff does not apply to the prepared vulnerable checkout, so fixed-side verification is expected to rely on the authoritative -fix image if incremental patch application fails.

nodes.state: Parser::makeStream calls entry->getFlag(XRefEntry::Parsing) on the XRefEntry pointer it just obtained from xref->getEntry(objNum, false).
At the direct-xref parse-failure event, i + 1 exceeds size, so the requested entry lies beyond the logically initialized xref range.

edges.relation: The XRefEntry pointer chosen by XRef::getEntry on the parse-failure path becomes the same entry pointer that Parser::makeStream dereferences at entry->getFlag(XRefEntry::Parsing).
